name: Disable Visual Effects
description: Disables Windows visual effects like transparency and animations to reduce UI overhead.

description_i18n.en: Disables Windows visual effects like transparency and animations to reduce UI overhead.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert visülle Effekte wie Transparenz und Animationen, um den Overhead der Benutzeroberfläche zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les effets visuels de Windows comme la transparence et les animations pour réduire le surcoût d'interface.

warnings.title: Interface refresh
warnings.message: Windows Explorer will close briefly and reopen immediately after changes are applied to take effect

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies registry values at HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize, HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced, and HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop to disable transparency, taskbar animations, visual effects settings, accessibility animations, and window minimization animation
